summary.name: Nylas
summary.one_liner: Nylas is a developer API for reading, sending, syncing and scheduling email, calendar and meeting data across Gmail, Microsoft, Exchange, IMAP and other providers, plus hosted AI agent accounts.
use_cases: Add email sending and syncing to a SaaS app
Let an AI agent send and receive email and book meetings
Build a CRM integration with Gmail and Outlook
Embed meeting scheduling in an app
Get transcripts and action items from Zoom, Google Meet or Teams meetings
Connect AI tools like Claude Code or Cursor to email and calendar
summary.what_it_does: Nylas provides a single JSON API to send, receive, thread and parse email across Gmail, Microsoft Graph, Exchange and any IMAP server, and to sync calendars from Google, Microsoft, Exchange and iCloud. It includes a native Scheduler with embeddable booking components and Virtual Calendars for rooms and equipment. Agent Accounts give AI agents hosted mailboxes and calendars under an application-owned address. A Notetaker API uses a managed bot to join Google Meet, Teams and Zoom meetings and deliver recordings, speaker-labeled transcripts, summaries and action items by webhook. The page also lists an MCP server, SDKs for JavaScript, Ruby, Python and Kotlin, webhooks, a developer dashboard and sandbox environments.
notable: One normalized schema across Gmail, Microsoft, Exchange, IMAP and 250+ providers
Agent Accounts provision an inbox and calendar for AI agents in one API call
MCP server exposing 36 typed tools for email, calendar, contacts and Notetaker
Notetaker API joins Google Meet, Teams and Zoom with a claimed 99% join success rate
caveats: Page says 'Start building for free; upgrade when you're ready' but does not list paid tier prices
Google and Microsoft OAuth handling and provider access depend on Nylas service terms not shown on this page
Platform list refers to API access; the page does not name desktop or mobile apps for Nylas itself
